title: Tangshan port, Jingtang port area VTS (唐山港京唐港区)
authority: Hebei MSA, Tangshan MSA (唐山海事局) VTS centre
applies_to: Ships navigating, anchoring or berthing in the Jingtang port area waters (no published VTS rules found).
applies_quote: 冀航警52/22，渤海，唐山港京唐港区VHF09频道受到干扰，暂调至VHF12频道工作,恢复时间另行通知，希各航船注意。

when.text: No local VTS rules with report points were found. Expect the usual Chinese VTS reports on the working channel: on reaching the VTS area, before entering or leaving the channel, before weighing anchor, after anchoring, before unberthing and after berthing. Obey the VTS traffic organisation. (Not printed in a Jingtang source; general practice, inferred.)

how.note: VTS working channel of the Jingtang port area, shown by navigation warning 冀航警52/22 (title 'VTS频道干扰'). In Feb 2022 it moved to CH 12 for a while and was restored (冀航警58/22).

ports: Tangshan port, Jingtang port area (唐山港京唐港区), Hebei

sources.title: 冀航警52/22 VTS频道干扰 (and English HB35/22)
关于唐山港京唐港区3号锚地调整的通告
sources.ref: anchorages 3-1 and 3-2 (3-2 closed to non-Chinese ships)

verification: Only navigation warnings found on msa.gov.cn; no VTS rules, VTS area or report line for Jingtang were found on msa.gov.cn or hb.msa.gov.cn.
notes: GAP: no published Jingtang VTS rules, VTS area, report lines, call sign or phone found. Channel VHF09 is from a 2022 warning; check with the agent. Anchorage 3-2 is a temporary anchorage closed to non-Chinese ships (2021 notice). Not inside the Caofeidian reporting system (east line 118 55.00E).
